_comment: Live theme (Enterprise 2.0.1, ibBan) to Weft. Kept in sync with docs/migration-map.md. Setting rules: "newId", {"to": id or [ids], "values": {live: weft}}, or {"drop": reason}. $set adds Weft values the live section had no setting for. Block rules: {"to": type, "settings": {...}, "blocks": {...}} or {"drop": reason}; "variants" pick a rule by setting content; "handler" names a function in scripts/src/migration-handlers.mjs.

approved._comment: Approved decisions (brief §5) that replace the live value in the store config.

reasons.schemes: Yellow primary button approved in brief §5 (#FBD816 / #0F1111, hover #E8C70F) replaces the live black button.
reasons.main-product: Mobile sticky bar approved in brief §5 (retail) replaces the theme's own sticky panel, which was off. Owner layout spec (28 Sep 2026): full-width product row from 1440 px, media 65% in a two-column grid, 60 px gap, as on the live store.
reasons.scheme-4: Accessibility floor: white button text on the live orange accent (#ff580d) was 3.16:1; dark text (#0F1111) meets 4.5:1.
reasons.main-collection: Owner layout spec (28 Sep 2026): filters in a drawer so the grid uses the full width; 2 / 3 / 4 / 4 columns (mobile, tablet, desktop, wide).
reasons.blocks:main-product: The live theme sold wholesale through SparkLayer / BSS markup, which is dropped (native B2B only). Weft's wholesale blocks (terms, tier table, one-size stepper, order matrix) replace it so the B2B market shows per-piece prices, rules and the matrix; buy buttons are retail-only so wholesale buyers order through the matrix or stepper. Owner request (28 Sep 2026): for wholesale buyers the order matrix follows the title and price, in the rows layout with the minimum order and pack bar, as on the live store.
